class.name: ProceduralWorld
class.brief_description: Deterministic procedural heightmaps, terrain erosion, point scattering, and world chunk coordinates.
class.description: ProceduralWorld provides core algorithms for procedural terrain and world-building tools. It does not create meshes or modify scenes. Its methods are deterministic for identical inputs. Terrain editing, mesh streaming, foliage instancing, and visual PCG graphs are separate higher-level features.

method.name: generate_heightmap
method.description: Returns width × height row-major samples of multi-octave value noise, using origin as the first sample's world coordinate so neighboring heightmap tiles can meet seamlessly. Sizes are capped to protect memory usage.

method.name: erode_heightmap
method.description: Applies conservative four-neighbor thermal erosion to a row-major heightmap without modifying the input.

method.name: scatter_points
method.description: Deterministically scatters points within area with at least min_distance separation. The number returned may be lower than max_points. Adjacent scatter calls are independent and do not enforce spacing across their boundaries.

method.name: get_chunk_coordinates
method.description: Returns Vector2i chunk coordinates intersected by the specified half-open rectangle, supporting negative world coordinates.
